card.name: First digit of a dose amount
card.fires_on: The space or first digit just before a dose number such as 4 mg, 30 mg, 60 mg or 80 mg, in dosing instructions for a named tablet or capsule.

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: The space right after 'tablets' or 'dosage of', just before the dose number.
modes.example: The maximum recommended dosage is fesoterodine fumarate extended-release tablets<< >>4 mg orally once daily in adult patients

modes.label: Leading digit of a two-digit dose
modes.description: The first digit of a dose such as 60 or 80 mg/day, after 'up to', 'above' or 'exceed'.
